How to change your language setting in ChatGPT

supports_dutch.evidence: Web search summary: "Yes, Dutch is supported. ChatGPT supports several languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Arabic, and Chinese."
supports_dutch.note: Dutch is also an interface language (Settings > General > Language, per OpenAI's help center). The search summary adds that quality is best in languages with a large digital footprint.

sources.title: OpenAI offers business users data storage option in Europe
OpenAI to let Europeans store data locally amid GDPR concerns

eu_data_residency.evidence: Web search summary: "OpenAI announced data residency in Europe for ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Edu, and the API Platform ... New ChatGPT Enterprise and Edu customers can choose to have customer content stored at rest in Europe."
eu_data_residency.note: Option for new ChatGPT Enterprise and Edu workspaces and for new API projects with region Europe. The announcement does not cover Free, Plus or Pro.

sources.title: OpenAI GDPR Compliance: what businesses need to know

gdpr_dpa.evidence: Web search summary: "OpenAI will execute Data Processing Addenda with customers for ChatGPT Business, ChatGPT Enterprise, and the API Platform to support GDPR compliance"; the DPA is entered with "OpenAI Ireland Ltd. for customers in European Economic Area countries or Switzerland".
gdpr_dpa.note: For ChatGPT Business, Enterprise and the API Platform; ChatGPT Edu is covered by a Student Data Privacy Agreement instead.

sources.title: How to stop your interactions with AI chatbots and social platforms being used to train AI models
How to Opt Out of ChatGPT Model Training (OpenAI)

trains_on_user_data.evidence: Web search summary: "By default, any conversations you have with the free or Plus versions of ChatGPT can be used by OpenAI to train future versions of ChatGPT ... you can opt out ... Data Controls > Improve the model for everyone > Switch off the toggle."
trains_on_user_data.note: On by default for Free, Plus and Pro (personal workspace); switch off 'Improve the model for everyone' under Data Controls. Opting out does not remove data already used in completed training runs.
